mentions.name: Maamut95
mentions.description: Maamut95 is a learning project that simulates all of an operating system's processes, implemented with Python and React. It is intended to help its builder understand how an OS works, with substantial assistance from AI during development.
mentions.problem: The builder feels clueless about how an operating system works and built the simulator to learn.
mentions.audience: The builder themselves, for personal learning about operating systems.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm trying the make an "OS" that simulates all of the OS processes on Python and React called Maamut95. I'm kinda clueless about how an OS works, so that's why I've gotten help from AI a lot. This is some kind of learning project.
